title: How To Create Garments For Inzoi Using Marvelous Designer Everywear
description:
Learn step by step how to create amazing garments for the InZOI game using Marvelous Designer Everywear! In this video, we show you how to use Everywear to design your garments, then export them using the InZOI Modkit, and finally, share your mod through Connect Gamewear.
